articles.title: Science
articles.description: I have always been interested in sciences, particularly in astronomy and physics. Growing up I also started working on tiny programming projects, in QBasic on Windows 98, for example to create a Rock, Paper, Scissors game based on a random number. Recently I am also keeping an eye on the (relatively) recent developments of neural networks and AI, which is rapidly changing the way we work as Software Developers.

articles.title: Sports and Nature
articles.description: I had the chance to grow up very close to the Bouconne forest near Toulouse, and I have always been fascinated by the beauty of nature. Now that I am living in the genevois, I have even more opportunities to hike and ski.

articles.title: Travels
articles.description: I had the chance to visit many countries (and cities) around the world, and I have always been curious about different cultures and ways of life.
